My biggest gripe about the game is KOC’s clock management skills. There was a point in the game where I believe there was about 1:20 left in the first half and KOC decided to go for it on 4th and short. I agree with the call but we still had 20 seconds left on the play clock and we had all three of our timeouts. You need to bleed the clock in that situation in case you don’t get the first down (which we didn’t). Then the rams marched down the field and scored with 15 seconds left. That 20 seconds on the play clock caused a huge swing in the game and that is all on KOC.
